{{Quote|On Froz we have a saying. 'Things are bad when there are more questions than answers, but worse, but worse, when there are more answers than questions.' You ask me one question, but I could give you a dozen, a hundred answers.|Governor-General Micamberlecto|<ref name="AC" />}}
'''Frozians''' were furry [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoids]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Froz]]. They were taller and thinner than [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and an extra joint in each [[Limb/Legends|limb]] gave them an off putting aspect. They also had whiskers reaching beyond the sides of their faces. Standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was too strong for them, speeding their aging process and preventing them from breeding. They also needed flora from Froz for this last process.

==Biology==
[[File:FrozianAlienEncounters.png|thumb|left|200px|A Frozian]]
Frozians were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]].<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> These bipedal<ref name="KotOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> beings had an extra joint in each [[Limb/Legends|limb]] that, to [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], looked like a breach in a [[Bone/Legends|bone]]. The movements of a Frozian were perceived as off putting<ref name="AC" /> and their gait was seen as weird,<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> partly because they trotted<ref name="UAA" /> like the animals they evolved from,<ref name="AE" /> and because they moved faster than Humans.<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /> Frozians were clumsier than Humans, but they had more acute senses and were better abstract thinkers.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" />

Thin<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> and reedy,<ref name="AC" /> adult Frozians reached a height of between two and three [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="AE" /> with the mean approaching the latter figure.<ref name="UAA" /> [[Gender/Legends|Males and females]] were similarly built and had no appreciable difference in height.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> The whole body of a Frozian was covered in short fur<ref name="AE" /> that could be of a range of color, including blond,<ref name="AA" /> reddish blond,<ref name="UAA" /> chestnut,<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> brown<ref name="AE" /> and golden brown.<ref name="AC" />

The head of a Frozian showed no external ears<ref name="AC" /> and a small, lipless mouth.<ref name="AE" /> A Frozian also had two wide-apart brown,<ref name="AC" /> big eyes,<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> one to each side of the snout<ref name="AE" /> to provide the Frozian with good peripheral sight.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> The end of the snout had an identifiable nose<ref name="AE" /> that the Frozian could swing.<ref name="AC" /> Some Frozians showed a [[Feline/Legends|feline]] head,<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> with others having a pear-shaped head<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> and even others having a Human-like head, except for the big moustache.<ref name="AE" />

Thick,<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> black,<ref name="AE" /> long<ref name="AC" /> whiskers grew to each side of the snout,<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> creating a huge moustache that reached beyond the cheeks.<ref name="AE" /> Whenever a Frozian moved his or her nose, the moustache bounced.<ref name="AE" /> Frozians consciously moved the nose in elaborated gestures to underline an opinion<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> when in a debate,<ref name="AA" /> and this caused the moustache to move from one side to the other.<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" />

Experiencing the standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] found on most inhabitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] was particularly difficult for a Frozian. While a Frozian can reach one century of age under light gravity conditions, eighty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of age would mean [[Death/Legends|death]] to Frozians under standard gravity.<ref name="AE" /> Furthermore, Frozians could only breed in light gravity conditions and under the influence of some specific vegetables from the planet [[Froz]].<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> A Frozian's body showed the first changes of adolescence at nine years of age, and a fourteen-year-old Frozian was considered an adult. At forty-one, age was starting to ravage a Frozian body, and at sixty-one Frozians were considered old. A Frozian of eighty-five years of age was venerable.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" />

Frozians could use the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and some of them showed potential to become members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="UAA" />

==Culture==
Frozians had a well-deserved reputation for probity,<ref name="AC" /> honesty and diligence.<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> They were proud hard-workers<ref name="UAA" /> and respected the letter of a promise to death,<ref name="AE" /> even if the other party had already betrayed it.<ref name="AA" /> These virtues made Frozian highly valued civil servants wherever they were,<ref name="AE" /> specially as they not only held the virtues of their society,<ref name="AE" /> but also the virtues and laws of any civilization they were working for.<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" />

Easily integrating in alien societies,<ref name="AE" /> they tended to speak the official [[Language/Legends|language]] of the place they called home,<ref name="AE" /><ref name="UAA" /> although they were also fluent in their native [[Frozian (language)|Frozian]].<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> Frozian language did not share grammar with [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]: Frozians tended to repeat the same sentence for emphasis, and sometimes they did so when speaking Basic.<ref name="AC" /> This language was spoken not only by Frozians: [[Maki Salak]], a [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] environmental extremist who had lived on [[Sacorria]], was fluent in Frozian language.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

A strong-willed,<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> good-willing people, Frozians tended to help whoever was in need,<ref name="AE" /> and could become worried for those around them. Frozians tended to make an extra effort to take care of people they perceived as needing it.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" />

A trait common to the species was melancholy: Frozians tended to see the worst possible outcome of everything,<ref name="AE" /> resigning themselves to their own doom,<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> or accepting<ref name="AA" /> any government ruling them, even if they dislike it.<ref name="AE" /> They had a tendency to depress,<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> except sometimes when helping other people,<ref name="UAA" /> and they had a natural skill to wreak havoc on the mood of anyone around them&mdash;even if the Frozians would never intend or want that.<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> Frozians tended to reject<ref name="AE" /> contact with other Frozians.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" />

A Frozian individual had a single name, such as Carlisgontoris, Rocatrinicel, Scorylance<ref name="UAA" /> or [[Micamberlecto]].<ref name="AC" /> They were known to swear with the expression "I wish to Froz".<ref name="AC" />

==History==
[[File:Frozian_UAA.jpg|thumb|right|130px|A Frozian]]

Frozians evolved from high trotting creatures that moved through the prairies of Froz and used their double-jointed limbs to reach [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] in treetops. Frozians eventually were visited by [[Alien/Legends|alien]] beings. Frozian learned from these people and they built their own [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They intended to visit other planets in [[Froz system/Legends|their system]], and then in other systems, learning from the universe. Soon, Frozians discovered they were the only sentient life in their system.<ref name="AE" />

Froz, in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> became a peaceful planet where most Frozians lived.<ref name="AE" /> Eventually the Frozians joined the galactic community, but the dominant culture in the sector, the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] from the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], treated the Frozians and other aliens in their sector (including the [[Corragut]]s and the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]]) less-than-optimally as a client species.<ref name="CatCW" />

In [[3951 BBY]], during the [[First Jedi Purge]], Frozians were known to the galaxy. They used the [[Frozian scout belt]] to make up for their usual clumsiness; but this item was exported so that aliens could use it too: The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mira]] was a known user of the Frozian belt.<ref name="KotOR2" />

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was founded in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Frozians and [[Duro/Legends|Duros]] were two of the first species to become its supporters.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], too many Frozians were known to sympathize with the Alliance, rejecting its opponent, the ruling [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="AE" /> Duros suffered no retaliation for their position, but Frozians did:<ref name="AA" /> The [[Naomi Dargon|Moff]] of the Corellian sector, ordered to [[Devastation of Froz|attack]] Froz<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> with a devastating orbital bombing<ref name="AE" /> to make an example for other systems<ref name="AA" /> and to discourage insurrection.<ref name="UAA" />

Through a series of raids, [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] annihilated almost all the life on the planet's surface.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> Few Frozians were off-planet at that point.<ref name="AE" /> Those Frozian survivors openly joined the Alliance in response,<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> devoting their lives to overthrow the Empire.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" />

A scientific discovery made soon afterward showed that Frozians were sterile without Froz's flora and gravity conditions.<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> The Galactic Empire was fragmented in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> and a number of Frozians joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="AC" /> but the generation of Frozians seeing their victory would be the last one ever,<ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> with estimations giving the species only a century of life. A number of<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" /> Frozian<ref name="AE" /> scientists began a desperate, against-the-clock research to re-create the environment of Froz before that.<ref name="AE" /><ref name="AA" /><ref name="UAA" />

==Frozians in the galaxy==
Micamberlecto was a Frozian member of the New Republic. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], he was appointed [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. He accepted the job, believing that it would fill other Frozians with pride and dignity. However, Micamberlecto was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]].<ref name="CTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Frozian species first appeared through the character of Micamberlecto in ''[[Ambush at Corellia]]'', the first installment of ''[[Star Wars: The Corellian Trilogy]]'', by [[Roger MacBride Allen]]. Micamberlecto was also the first Frozian to be graphically depicted, in an image by [[Storn Cook]] for the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] guide ''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]'' ([[1997]]) that showed a pear-headed officer. [[Joe Bavitz]] drew a generic Frozian with an oversized moustache for ''[[Alien Encounters]]'' ([[1998]]). In ''[[Alien Anthology]]'' ([[2001]]), [[Sam Wood]] provided the first colored image of the species, showing a pair of Frozians with less Humanoid, more grazer-like faces and a less apparent moustache&mdash;although the whiskers were still apparent. A very tall Frozian with a similarly grazer face, drawn by an unknown artist, appeared in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' ([[2003]]). Those two last book provide different role-playing stats for a generic Frozian commoner.
